data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic words ‘bam’ meaning ‘bright’ and ‘berg’ meaning ‘mountain’. This name was likely given to someone living near a bright mountain or one who was considered bright or shining. The name Bamberger carries the meaning “Bright mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bamberger usually hope their child will grow to embody bright mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
